## Standing rules

- Config, not code - vertical and country differences resolve to config; 14 engines carry all 815 units.
- Customer-owned channels - growth and social publish only from the customer's connected accounts.
- Probabilistic components flag, collect and draft - never clear, diagnose, advise or approve.

## Mechanism families — the engines

| MF | Family | Units | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| [MF1](engines/mf1.md) | Conversational intake & triage | 98 | existing | Understands a request, gathers structured detail, routes it |
| [MF2](engines/mf2.md) | Case / matter state machine | 80 | existing | Long-running case objects with stages, clocks and updates - matters, claims, tickets, NCRs, permits, applications |
| [MF3](engines/mf3.md) | Exception-queue triage | 52 | existing | Watches a queue and surfaces only what needs a human |
| [MF4](engines/mf4.md) | Clock & calendar engine | 73 | existing | Renewal, recall, statutory, covenant, AR and reminder dates |
| [MF5](engines/mf5.md) | Sequence engine | 54 | existing | Multi-touch follow-up, save, reactivation and referral journeys |
| [MF6](engines/mf6.md) | Document collection & assembly | 100 | existing | Chases, checks and assembles document sets - KYC, dossiers, RFPs, grants, customs packs |
| [MF7](engines/mf7.md) | Watcher / surveillance | 92 | existing | Monitors internal and external signals - rates, literature, competitors, parity, benchmarks |
| [MF8](engines/mf8.md) | Reconciliation | 32 | existing | Matches records across systems and works the exceptions |
| [MF9](engines/mf9.md) | Vision assessment | 12 | existing | Photo and video assessment - damage, progress, proof, portfolio, shelf audit |
| [MF10](engines/mf10.md) | Capacity & scheduling optimization | 53 | existing | Slots, dispatch, routes, waitlists and class capacity |
| [MF11](engines/mf11.md) | Telephony / voice | 3 | **new** | Calls answered, transcribed and mined; missed-call recovery |
| [MF12](engines/mf12.md) | Publishing & platform connectors | 12 | **new** | SEO/AEO surfaces, social publishing, ad-platform sync, MCP endpoint |
| [MF13](engines/mf13.md) | Creative generation | 13 | **new** | Operations-grounded content plus ModelArk image and video assets |
| [MF14](engines/mf14.md) | Protocol & incident playbooks | 141 | **new** | Event-triggered, time-boxed, safety-gated playbooks: statutory clocks, escalation chains, hard interlocks. Escalation IS the product - the agent recognizes, executes steps, and stops at the human gate |

## Archetypes

| | Archetype | Recognise it by | Primary lever | Anchors |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | Emergency trades | Urgent, unplanned, out-of-hours demand | Speed to lead (sub-60s) | A6, A3 (dispatch window), D1, F2 |
| B | Booked personal services | Recurring appointments; chair/room/practitioner capacity | Reminders + rebooking | D1, D2, C4 |
| C | Regulated professions | Licensed, advice-giving, matter-based work | Qualification, then progress updates | A2, D4, matter overlays |
| D | Project trades | Quoted work, site visit, multi-week cycle | Quote follow-up | C6, B2, A5 |
| E | Recurring B2B contracts | Contracted service, notice periods, renewal dates | Renewal calendar | D6, B2 |
| F | Hospitality & venues | Covers, rooms, events, deposits | Response speed on high-value enquiries | A2 (value-routed), D5 |
| G | Clinical & health | Recall intervals, treatment plans | Recall + reactivation | C4, C3, D1 |
| H | Education & training | Cohorts, terms, enrolment cycles | Trial-to-paid + term-break retention | C6, C3, cohort overlays |
| I | Property & lettings | Viewings, tenancies, statutory dates | Statutory dates + viewing speed | D6, A3 |
| J | Retail product-led | Walk-in, stock, no client record | Weak fit - availability only (deprioritise) | A8, D7 |
